name: Default Agent Failure Rules
description: Common agent-trace anomalies over DProvenanceKit's vendor-neutral event vocabulary (tool_call.*, llm_call.*, agent_invocation.*). These names are produced by `dprovenancekit ingest` (OTel/OTLP traces) and by the live integrations in canonical mode: openai-agents `register(store, canonical=True)`, LangChain `DProvenanceTracer.trace(..., canonical=True)`. Without canonical mode the integrations emit framework-native names (openai-agents `function.*`, LangChain `toolStarted`) that this preset won't match — enable canonical mode, ingest via OTel, or write a preset targeting the native types. Rules whose signal needs data no emitter yet produces (a registered-tool list, a distinct tool-result-vs-reasoning event) are intentionally omitted until the emitters carry it. The runaway rule counts tool calls per engine (the tool name emitters stamp on each event), so it fires when a single tool is hammered, not when many distinct tools are each used a few times; under an emitter that stamps one fixed engine on every tool event it degrades to a total tool-call budget.

rules.message: Runaway tool use: a single tool was invoked more than 10 times in one run — the agent is likely stuck looping it.
One or more tool calls completed after the last model step, so their results were never consumed.
